settings.label: Size attribute
settings.description: what drives node size: "uniform" (every node the same) or a column (a numeric value scales the size; a node without a number gets the uniform size)

settings.label: Color attribute
settings.description: what drives node colour: "original" (the colour from the data) or a column (category / list columns get one colour per value, numeric a gradient)

settings.label: Size scaling
settings.description: multiplies every node's size (bigger = all nodes bigger, hubs included); the contrast between small and big nodes comes from nodes.sizeAttribute + nodes.sizeMethod

settings.label: Min size
settings.description: floor for the smallest nodes after scaling (lower = more contrast)

settings.label: Size scaling method
settings.description: how the size attribute maps to size

settings.label: Color scaling method
settings.description: how a numeric colour attribute maps to the gradient

settings.label: Width attribute
settings.description: what drives edge width: "uniform" (every edge the same) or a numeric edge column (e.g. an RWR flow column; an edge without a value gets the uniform width)

settings.label: Color attribute
settings.description: what drives edge colour: "original" (the file's colour, else the blend of its two nodes) or an edge column

settings.label: Width scaling
settings.description: multiplies every edge's width (bigger = all edges wider); the contrast between thin and wide edges comes from edges.widthAttribute + edges.widthMethod

settings.label: Min width
settings.description: floor for the thinnest edges after scaling (lower = more contrast)

settings.label: Cut-off by
settings.description: the numeric edge column the edge cut-off compares ("none" = no cut-off; edges.cutoff is offered once a column is chosen)

settings.label: Opacity
settings.description: edge opacity

settings.label: Blending
settings.description: how edge colours combine where edges overlap

settings.label: Alpha by
settings.description: the numeric edge column the edge opacity follows, normalised between edges.minAlpha and edges.maxAlpha (offered once a column is chosen; "none" = full opacity)

settings.label: Fade Distance
settings.description: edges fade with distance from the camera (1 = no fade)

settings.label: Width scaling method
settings.description: how the width attribute maps to width

settings.label: Color scaling method
settings.description: how a numeric edge colour attribute maps to the gradient

settings.label: Node layout
settings.description: which precomputed layout positions the nodes (changing it flies the nodes to the new positions)

settings.label: Highlight nodes
settings.description: mark the selected nodes (bigger, glow); the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Highlight nodes › "Highlight nodes"

settings.label: Fade others
settings.description: dim the nodes outside the selection; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Highlight nodes › "Fade others"

settings.label: Fade opacity
settings.description: opacity of the dimmed nodes (0 = invisible); the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Highlight nodes › "Fade opacity"

settings.label: Highlight node size
settings.description: size factor of the selected nodes; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Highlight nodes › "Highlight node size"

settings.label: Glow opacity
settings.description: glow strength of the selected nodes; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Highlight nodes › "Glow opacity"

settings.label: Highlight edges
settings.description: mark the edges of the selection; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Edge highlighting › "Highlight edges"

settings.label: Edge width
settings.description: width factor of the selection edges; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Edge highlighting › "Edge width"

settings.label: Highlight edge opacity
settings.description: opacity factor of the selection edges; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Edge highlighting › "Highlight edge opacity"

settings.label: Fade other edges
settings.description: dim the edges outside the selection; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Edge highlighting › "Fade other edges"

settings.label: Fade edges opacity
settings.description: opacity of the dimmed edges (0 = hidden); the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Edge highlighting › "Fade edges opacity"

settings.label: Subset edges only
settings.description: draw only the edges of the selection; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Edge highlighting › "Subset edges only"

settings.label: Edge subset mode
settings.description: which edges count as the selection's: induced = both ends selected, incident = at least one end; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Edge highlighting › "Edge subset mode"

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: bloom glow: always, only for the selection, or off; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Highlight nodes › "Mode"

settings.label: Strength
settings.description: bloom intensity; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Highlight nodes › "Strength"

settings.label: Radius
settings.description: bloom spread; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Highlight nodes › "Radius"

settings.label: Threshold
settings.description: brightness from which bloom starts; the user changes it: Settings window (gear icon in the icon bar) › Highlight nodes › "Threshold"

settings.label: Mode
settings.description: camera controls: Trackball (free rotation), Orbit (around a target, up stays up), Map (pan / zoom)

settings.label: Speed
settings.description: camera movement speed

settings.label: Fog Distance
settings.description: distance at which the scene fades into the background

commands.label: Set a viz setting
commands.description: Sets one setting by its ring id (see the app catalog: nodes.colorAttribute, nodes.colorMethod = linear | log | symlog | quantile, nodes.sizeAttribute, edges.widthAttribute, edges.cutoffAttribute then edges.cutoff, edges.alphaAttribute, layout.nodeLayout, ...). Dropdown values must be one of the options: a column, or the built-in uniform (same size / width), original (the data's own colour) or none (no cut-off / alpha); numbers within the range. The highlight.* settings (highlight mode: how the selection is marked, fade others) are read-only here: tell the user what to change in the Settings window instead.

commands.label: Expand by 1 hop
commands.description: Adds every neighbour of the selected nodes to the subset.

commands.label: Connect subset
commands.description: Adds the connector nodes on shortest paths so the selection becomes one connected subgraph (Steiner-tree heuristic).

commands.label: Common neighbors
commands.description: Adds the nodes connected to every selected node.

commands.label: Prune leaf nodes
commands.description: Removes selected nodes with at most one edge to other selected nodes (repeat to peel further).

commands.label: Isolate mode
commands.description: Toggles isolate mode: everything outside the selection is hidden (a user choice, like the highlight settings).

commands.label: Subset layout
commands.description: Toggles a 3D layout of the selection only.

commands.label: Clear subset
commands.description: Clears the selection (same as subset.set without ids).

commands.label: Fly to subset
commands.description: Flies the camera to the current selection.

commands.label: Reset view
commands.description: Camera back to the start view.

commands.label: Next layout
commands.description: Switches to the next precomputed layout (settings.set layout.nodeLayout picks one by name).

commands.label: Previous layout
commands.description: Switches to the previous precomputed layout.

commands.label: List the view settings
commands.description: Every view setting with its id, label, category, type, options or range and current value - the ids settings.set accepts (highlight.* are read-only for the in-app agent; data.* are not settings).

commands.label: Export the config
commands.description: Returns a ready config.json payload of the current state (layout, presets, libraries, open windows, tooltips, ...). The current view is first saved as a preset (presetName, else "default", overwritten) and becomes lastUsedPreset. localStorage (window positions) only with includeLocalStorage.

commands.label: Switch dataset
commands.description: Loads another dataset from data/index.json (closes every window, clears the subset; an agent session belongs to one dataset, start a new one afterwards). Datasets: ppicml = PPI CML, ppicml_old = PPI CML (old), hereditary_ataxias = Hereditary ataxias, hereditary_cardiomyopathies = Hereditary cardiomyopathies. Aliases (old keys) are accepted.

commands.label: Open a window
commands.description: Opens an analysis window with settings (see the app catalog for the window types and their options, e.g. type=distribution with selectedColumn and useGlobal; type=scatter with colX, colY; type=enrichment with selectedColumn). Wrong column names or values are errors; unknown option keys are ignored. Returns the window id (for window.configure / window.close).

commands.label: Change an open window
commands.description: Changes the settings of an open window: by id (from the app context, e.g. popout-distribution) or, without id, the most recently opened window of a type (type=distribution - e.g. one a card of yours just opened). The new options are merged into its current ones and applied in place - same window, same id (selectedColumn, useGlobal = G / S toggle, ...). A null value removes the option (back to the default). Returns the window id and the previous values of the changed options.

commands.label: Close a window
commands.description: Closes an open window by id (from the app context). Returns its type and settings, so it can be opened again.

commands.label: Random walk with restart
commands.description: Runs the app's GPU random walk with restart from seed nodes (default: the current selection). Adds the node columns rwr_<name>_rank_n and rwr_<name>_probability_n and, by default, the EDGE column rwr_<name>_flow_n (the walk's flow per edge; edgeMetrics: false for none, or a list of flow | flowMin | geoMean). Show the edge column too: edges.colorAttribute and/or edges.widthAttribute = rwr_<name>_flow_n with edges.colorMethod / edges.widthMethod symlog or quantile. alpha = restart probability (default 0.7), beta (default 0.3). topN saves the top-N nodes as the library subset rwr_<name>_top<N> - leave it out unless the user asked for a subset. Returns the columns and the ten best-ranked nodes; the new columns are in input/nodes.tsv and input/edges.tsv right after the call.

commands.label: Clustering
commands.description: Runs the app's clustering: k-NN graph on the coordinates of a layout ('default' = current positions) + Louvain (or leiden-simple), writes a category column (default cluster_<n>_c; clusters numbered from 1, -1 = noise for clusters smaller than minClusterSize, default 5). k (default 15), resolution (default 1). Returns the column name and cluster sizes.

commands.label: Save subset to library
commands.description: Adds a named node list to the subset library and tags its nodes in the subsets_a column. Ids are node ids (_id in nodes.tsv); a bare name means every node of that name (all copies on multiplex data). No ids: the current selection. A taken name gets _2, _3, ...; the name actually used is returned.

commands.label: Set subset
commands.description: Makes the given node ids the current subset (selection); a bare name selects every node of that name (all copies on multiplex data). No ids (or an empty list) clears the subset.

commands.label: Add to subset
commands.description: Adds the given node ids to the current subset (selection); a bare name adds every node of that name.

commands.label: Make a node active
commands.description: Makes one node the active node - what the pulse, the open Molecular Structure windows (structure3d), the logbook and the multiplayer view follow; the selection stays. node = a node id (_id) or a name (several copies: the first one; the result says how many). fly: true also flies the camera to it.

commands.label: Add node columns
commands.description: Adds node columns from a TSV text (first column _id, then columns named with a kind suffix: _n, _c, _a, _kv, _norm). They become temporary columns usable in every window.

commands.label: Open a molecule in AR
commands.description: Opens a protein node's 3D structure (AlphaFold) in the AR molecule mode, for everyone in the session who is in AR (it replaces an open one). `node` = the node id or its name (gene). A desktop shows nothing in 3D.

commands.label: Select a residue of the AR molecule
commands.description: Selects a residue (its number) of the open AR molecule for everyone: its side chains, the list row and the detail card; null clears the selection. Never moves the molecule.

commands.label: Filter the AR molecule's residues
commands.description: Switches a chip of the open AR molecule's residue list on or off for everyone: `row` consequence (e.g. pathogenic) or type, `key` the chip as the list shows it. A filter that hides the selected residue deselects it.

commands.label: Close the AR molecule
commands.description: Closes the open AR molecule for everyone (the network comes back).
